items.name: Kukri
items.description: The blade of this foot-long knife curves inward and lacks a cross guard at the hilt.

items.name: Shuriken
items.description: This "throwing star" is a small piece of flat metal with sharp edges, designed to be flung with a flick of the wrist.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Disguise Kit
items.description: This small wooden box contains cosmetics, false facial hair, spirit gum, and a few simple wigs. You usually need a disguise kit to set up a disguise in order to Impersonate someone using the Deception skill. If you've crafted a large number of disguises, you can replenish your cosmetics supply with replacement cosmetics suitable for the type of your disguise kit.

items.name: Thieves' Tools
items.description:
You need thieves' tools to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Pick a Lock]{Pick Locks} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.Disable a Device]{Disable Devices} (of some types) using the Thievery skill.

If your thieves' tools are broken, you can repair them by replacing the lock picks with @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Thieves' Toolkit (Replacement Picks)]{Replacement Picks} appropriate to your tools; this doesn't require using the Repair action.

offensiveAbilities.name: Envenom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Effect Using either saliva or blood, the vishkanya applies vishkanyan venom to one weapon they're holding. To use their blood, they must be injured, or they can deal themselves 1 Slashing Damage damage as part of the action.

offensiveAbilities.name: Flexible
offensiveAbilities.description: The vishkanya infiltrator is adept at dealing with tight situations. They have a +1 circumstance bonus to checks to Escape.

offensiveAbilities.name: Proficient Poisoner
offensiveAbilities.description: The vishkanya infiltrator doesn't lose the poison on a weapon due to a critically failed Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The vishkanya deals 1d6 extra precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Vishkanyan Venom
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d4 Poison Damage damage (1 round)

Stage 2 1d4 Poison Damage damage and Off-Guard (1 round)

Stage 3 1d4 Poison Damage damage, off-guard, and a -5-foot penalty to Speed (1 round)
